title: Piercing
summary: PIERCING, participle present tense pers'ing. Penetrating; entering, as a pointed instrument; making a way by force into another body. 1. Affecting deeply; as eloquence piercing the heart. 2. adjective

inlines.v: PIERCING, participle present tense pers'ing. Penetrating; entering, as a pointed instrument; making a way by force into another body. 1. Affecting deeply; as eloquence piercing the heart. 2. adjective Affecting; cutting; keen.
